n3a4d188162.headline: Wall Street ticks closer to its record after Oracle rallies
n3a4d188162.summary: US stock indexes ticked higher on Thursday after another encouraging update on US inflation. Oracle shares rallied, pushing the market closer to its record.
n3a4d188162.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies and is a key gauge of American equity market performance for global investors.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: Oracle shares rallied during the session, contributing to the broader market gain.

n07ff5bbe4c.headline: DIM launches long-term installment plan in hryvnias at 10% interest for homebuyers
n07ff5bbe4c.summary: DIM Group launched a proprietary long-term hryvnia installment plan at a 10% annual interest rate for buying residential property in its projects. The company's press service announced the plan.
n07ff5bbe4c.why: DIM Group is a Ukrainian residential developer, and its financing terms reflect conditions in the local mortgage and housing market.

ndddeb820bf.headline: Binance Wants Kenya Govt to Regulate Digital Assets
ndddeb820bf.summary: Binance, a global blockchain ecosystem and cryptocurrency infrastructure provider, has called for digital assets to be regulated in Kenya.
ndddeb820bf.why: Binance is one of the largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and regulatory frameworks for digital assets determine how crypto firms can operate and attract investment.

n9c45360892.headline: Council tax bills set to rise at fastest rate for two decades, economist warns
n9c45360892.summary: An economist warns council tax bills in the UK will rise at the fastest rate in two decades, while Chancellor Rachel Reeves said ministers will not go above five annual increases.
n9c45360892.why: Council tax funds local government and feeds into household costs and inflation, affecting consumer spending and UK fiscal policy.

n75308d97e3.headline: Canada’s Trans Mountain Pipeline Could Boost Capacity by 2027
n75308d97e3.summary: Canada's Trans Mountain pipeline could expand again by 2027, enabling more crude oil exports to Asia, particularly China. The expansion aims to reduce dependence on US markets.
n75308d97e3.why: Trans Mountain carries Canadian crude from Alberta to the Pacific coast, and added capacity affects heavy crude pricing differentials and export routes.

nfc4a9c5f4a.headline: China offers zero-tariff access to African nations | Uganda Business News
nfc4a9c5f4a.summary: Xi Jinping pledged zero-tariff treatment for Uganda and 52 other African nations, eliminating duties on all tariff lines for their goods. The move aims to boost Sino-African trade.
nfc4a9c5f4a.why: Tariff changes alter trade flows between China and African exporters, affecting commodity shipments and import costs.

source.name: Uganda Business News | News, analysis, comment, and data from Uganda Business Ne

sources.name: Uganda Business News | News, analysis, comment, and data from Uganda Business Ne

n6649a595d7.headline: Companies received millions too much wage support in Covid by reporting larger losses
n6649a595d7.summary: A CPB analysis found Dutch companies likely received around 740 million euros in excess coronavirus wage support by reporting larger losses than they actually sustained.
n6649a595d7.why: The CPB is the Netherlands' official economic policy bureau, and its findings bear on how public funds were allocated during the pandemic.

nda049546ef.headline: Euro hits highest since late 2021, safe-haven Swiss franc and yen jump
nda049546ef.summary: The euro hit its highest against the U.S. dollar in almost four years as investors moved into safe-haven assets. Traders remained cautious about the impact of the U.S.-China trade deal.
nda049546ef.why: Currency moves reflect shifts in global risk appetite and affect the earnings and returns of international investors and exporters.

impacts.name: Swiss franc
impacts.why: Investors bought the franc as a safe-haven asset.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nda049546ef.why_moved: Investors moved into safe-haven currencies while remaining cautious about the impact of the U.S.-China trade deal.

ne890ad415d.headline: Retail inflation hits 6 year low at 2.82% in May, driven by cooling food prices - BusinessToday
ne890ad415d.summary: Retail inflation fell to a six-year low of 2.82% in May, driven by a drop in food inflation to 0.99% from 1.78% in April. Rural and urban food inflation were 0.95% and 0.96%.
ne890ad415d.why: Consumer price inflation guides central bank rate decisions, bond yields and the rupee.

nb8ae2585f1.headline: US to pull some personnel from the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran
nb8ae2585f1.summary: President Donald Trump said US personnel were being moved out of the Middle East because it could be dangerous. He also said the US would not allow Iran to have a nuclear weapon.
nb8ae2585f1.why: US military posture in the Middle East affects regional security, energy supply risk and the defence and oil sectors.

n58a54763fc.headline: Nifty falls after six sessions: Factors behind today's crash, market outlook and more - BusinessToday
n58a54763fc.summary: The Nifty fell 253 points to 24,888 after six sessions of gains, while the Sensex crashed 823 points to 81,691. The 50-stock index had gained 600 points in the previous six sessions.
n58a54763fc.why: The Nifty 50 and Sensex are the main benchmark indices of the Indian stock market, tracking the largest listed companies in India.
n58a54763fc.why_moved: The input reports a sharp one-day fall in both benchmarks after six sessions of gains, without naming a single cause.

nf4213e5826.headline: Sri Lanka sells extra Rs17.5bn Treasury bills after auction
nf4213e5826.summary: Sri Lanka sold 17.5 billion rupees of Treasury bills offered on tap after an auction, at average rates of 7.55% and 7.94%, the state debt office said.
nf4213e5826.why: Treasury bill auctions set short-term government borrowing costs and signal domestic interest rate levels for the rupee and the local bond market.

n97accaec1f.headline: US to pull some personnel from the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran
n97accaec1f.summary: US President Trump said the Middle East "could be a dangerous place" as the US pulls some personnel from the region. The decision comes amid deadlock in US-Iran talks and mutual threats of strikes.
n97accaec1f.why: Escalating US-Iran tensions raise the risk of disruption to Gulf oil flows, which is a key driver of crude oil prices.
n97accaec1f.why_moved: Deadlock in US-Iran talks and mutual threats of strikes raise the risk of supply disruption, which tends to lift oil prices.

n3c21ccb500.headline: Crude oil futures decline after previous session’s gains
n3c21ccb500.summary: Crude oil futures traded lower on Thursday morning after rising nearly 4% in the previous session on escalating tensions between the US and Iran.
n3c21ccb500.why: Crude oil futures set the global price benchmark for oil, which influences fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.

ne34ea51190.headline: Hopes Of A US-Canada Trade Deal Lifts Market Up
ne34ea51190.summary: Canadian stocks edged into positive territory on Thursday on hopes of a US-Canada trade deal, despite fresh tariff threats and geopolitical tensions.
ne34ea51190.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and trade relations with the US are central to Canadian corporate earnings and growth.

nacf25cba06.headline: EDF to buy Pod Point for £10.6m amid ‘slow’ electric car adoption
nacf25cba06.summary: EDF, already a majority shareholder, will take over the rest of Pod Point, the EV charging group, for £10.6m, the Bucks Free Press reports amid what it describes as slow electric car adoption.
nacf25cba06.why: EDF is a major French utility with growing EV charging operations, and consolidating a charging provider reflects the sector's shifting economics.

ndd0a984b78.headline: EDF to buy Pod Point for £10.6m amid ‘slow’ electric car adoption
ndd0a984b78.summary: EDF, already a majority shareholder, will take over the rest of Pod Point for £10.6m. The deal comes amid what the input describes as slow electric car adoption.
ndd0a984b78.why: EDF is a French energy utility with EV charging operations, and Pod Point is a UK electric vehicle charging company.

nfffef05fc2.headline: Musk spoke to Trump privately before posting message of ‘regret’
nfffef05fc2.summary: Elon Musk phoned Donald Trump late on Monday, before the billionaire publicly expressed regret on Wednesday for his attacks on the president. The account comes from three people briefed on the conversation.
nfffef05fc2.why: Elon Musk leads several major companies, including Tesla and SpaceX, so public disputes with the US president can affect investor sentiment and government contracts.

nbb455b66ff.headline: Linesight – Ireland construction industry projected to be among strongest in Europe in 2025 | Irish Building Magazine.ie | Ireland's Leading Construction News & Information Portal
nbb455b66ff.summary: Construction output across much of Europe is expected to rebound in 2025, with Ireland, Finland and Spain leading the recovery. Ireland's cost inflation is tracking slightly ahead of the wider market, according to Linesight.
nbb455b66ff.why: Linesight is a global construction consultancy, and its forecasts inform investment and development decisions in the property and construction sectors.

source.name: Irish building magazine | Ireland's Construction News Portal

sources.name: Irish building magazine | Ireland's Construction News Portal

nb909e67502.headline: Even counterfeit Labubu makers can’t keep up with demand
nb909e67502.summary: Demand for the Labubu plush toy is so strong that even factories making counterfeits cannot produce them fast enough, China Press reported.
nb909e67502.why: Labubu is a collectible toy line from Pop Mart, whose popularity drives sales and brand value for the Hong Kong-listed company.

nd067f56ab7.headline: Expanded SST impacts essential goods, says Dr Wee
nd067f56ab7.summary: A study of products on the expanded sales tax list shows that many everyday products used by the M40 and B40 groups will be taxed, according to MCA president Wee Ka Siong.
nd067f56ab7.why: Changes to sales and consumption taxes affect consumer prices, household spending and the retail sector.

n5f2c1727fd.headline: US leads foreign inflow into Kospi after 10-month lull
n5f2c1727fd.summary: Foreign investors bought shares worth roughly 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion) on the local stock market last month, with US investors spurring the buying, ending a 10-month lull.
n5f2c1727fd.why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock market index, and foreign flows are a key indicator of international investor sentiment toward Korean equities.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Net foreign share purchases last month, led by US investors, are a flow into the Korean market benchmark.

nc7931d176e.headline: Piyush Goyal highlights trade opportunities, sustainable growth during Sweden visit
nc7931d176e.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal discussed collaboration, a free trade agreement and investment opportunities with Sweden during his visit. The talks aim to strengthen bilateral trade ties.
nc7931d176e.why: Free trade agreements and investment flows between India and Sweden shape export access and foreign direct investment for companies in both countries.

n99b4ec89e6.headline: Stocks hit all-time high above 124,000-level
n99b4ec89e6.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's benchmark KSE-100 index reached an all-time high above the 124,000 level. The gains continued a strong buying spree in the post-budget session.
n99b4ec89e6.why: The KSE-100 is the main benchmark of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in the country.
n99b4ec89e6.why_moved: The post-budget session saw continued strong buying, following the decision to maintain a policy described in the source.

ne888265ece.headline: Singapore retail vacancies rise despite steady demand for prime space
ne888265ece.summary: Singapore's retail vacancy rate increased in the first quarter despite healthy demand for prime spaces and stable rental growth, according to a Savills report.
ne888265ece.why: Retail vacancy rates indicate the health of commercial property markets, which affect landlords and real estate investment trusts.

ncc75b6ecfc.headline: Germany counting on exemption from EU debt rules for defence boost
ncc75b6ecfc.summary: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil is confident the European Commission will grant Germany an exemption from EU debt rules. Berlin wants to ramp up defence spending.
ncc75b6ecfc.why: EU fiscal rules limit government borrowing across the euro area, and Germany is the bloc's largest economy. Exemptions would change its borrowing capacity and bond supply.

nd09da350f6.headline: Taoiseach expects rent caps to be extended nationwide by this summer
nd09da350f6.summary: Taoiseach expects rent caps to be extended nationwide by this summer, according to the Irish Prime Minister's comments reported by Donegal Live. Opposition parties have criticized rent control plans.
nd09da350f6.why: Rent regulation affects residential property investors, landlords and the housing market. Policy changes can influence rental yields and property valuations.

naea15fc07c.headline: Dr. S. Jaishankar Holds Key Meetings in Brussels to Advance India–EU Strategic and Economic Ties
naea15fc07c.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar held key meetings in Brussels aimed at advancing India-EU strategic and economic ties. The talks cover both strategic and economic relations.
naea15fc07c.why: The EU and India are negotiating deeper trade and investment links, which affect exporters, investors and supply chains. Strategic ties shape these commercial agreements.

n9e59dc7c3f.headline: Telus offers to fully own digital unit for greater control of AI capabilities
n9e59dc7c3f.summary: Telus plans to acquire its digital services subsidiary to strengthen control over AI technology and data strategy. The proposed deal offers a significant premium over current stock prices.
n9e59dc7c3f.why: Telus is a major Canadian telecommunications company whose digital unit handles AI and data services. Buying out a subsidiary changes control, cash commitments and the company's strategic focus.

ne3a4cded92.headline: China eyes stronger co-operation with ECB
ne3a4cded92.summary: China aims to enhance cooperation with the European Central Bank, including efforts to reform the international monetary system.
ne3a4cded92.why: International monetary cooperation affects currency stability, exchange rates, and global financial markets.

n7453a8e115.headline: Emirates and Air China enhance partnership
n7453a8e115.summary: Emirates and Air China signed a Memorandum of Understanding to enhance reciprocal interline cooperation.
n7453a8e115.why: Airline partnerships can improve connectivity and revenue through expanded networks.

na03a148b00.headline: Construction Begins on AAE-2 Subsea Cable by PCCW, Sparkle, Telecom Egypt, Zain Omantel
na03a148b00.summary: PCCW, Sparkle, Telecom Egypt, and Zain Omantel have started construction of the AAE-2 subsea cable, enhancing digital connectivity across Africa, Asia, and Europe.
na03a148b00.why: Subsea cables are critical infrastructure for global internet and data traffic, supporting economic growth and digital business expansion.

n183dbc23db.headline: PETRONAS terminations should be gradual, give training, says Muhyiddin
n183dbc23db.summary: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Muhyiddin Yassin urged that PETRONAS's planned layoff of 5,000 employees be conducted gradually and include training support.
n183dbc23db.why: PETRONAS is Malaysia's state oil company; workforce changes affect the energy sector and broader economy.

n8c1ec0fb16.headline: ‘Dangerous place’: US to pull personnel from Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran
n8c1ec0fb16.summary: US officials announced plans to pull personnel from the Middle East citing heightened security risks amid escalating tensions with Iran.
n8c1ec0fb16.why: US military and diplomatic moves in the Middle East can impact regional stability, energy markets, and global geopolitical risk premiums.
n8c1ec0fb16.why_moved: The US withdrawal announcement amid Iran tensions increased geopolitical risk perceptions, affecting energy and security-sensitive markets.

n94b63acc47.headline: MCA leaders warn of risks in SST expansion
n94b63acc47.summary: Malaysian MCA leaders caution that expanding the Sales and Services Tax (SST) from July 1 could trigger contract disputes and increase consumer costs.
n94b63acc47.why: Tax policy changes can affect business costs and consumer prices, impacting economic growth and market sentiment.

n9177051ea8.headline: OPEC+ Bets on Summer Demand as Q4 Glut Looms
n9177051ea8.summary: OPEC+ plans supply increases aligned with strong summer demand but analysts warn of a growing oil surplus in Q4 2024 and 2026.
n9177051ea8.why: OPEC+ supply decisions and demand forecasts influence global oil prices and energy market stability, affecting producers and consumers worldwide.

neffab797b0.headline: Cochlear launches new implant, downgrades guidance
neffab797b0.summary: Australian health technology company Cochlear launched a new implant but downgraded its sales guidance due to weaker-than-expected sales.
neffab797b0.why: Cochlear is a leading medical device company, and guidance changes can affect investor confidence and sector outlook.
neffab797b0.why_moved: The downgrade in sales guidance indicates weaker demand, leading to negative investor sentiment for Cochlear shares.

n1475a629d9.headline: Morocco: growing dependence on remittances from its diaspora?
n1475a629d9.summary: Remittances to Morocco from its diaspora are estimated at $12 billion, about 118 billion dirhams, placing the country third among African nations for such transfers.
n1475a629d9.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income for Morocco, so they affect its external balance and domestic demand.

n9e40778176.headline: Kenya: government presents budget one year after deadly protests
n9e40778176.summary: The Kenyan government presents its budget to Parliament on Thursday without massive tax increases, one year after deadly protests. The approach aims to avoid renewed street unrest.
n9e40778176.why: Kenya's annual budget sets government spending and tax policy, which shape fiscal deficits, borrowing needs and conditions for businesses and investors in East Africa's largest economy.

n2a05358ef4.headline: Debt reduction: Egypt cedes a strategic plot of land to the Ministry of Finance
n2a05358ef4.summary: Egypt has ceded a strategic plot of land to the Ministry of Finance, with the allocation aimed at reducing public debt and simplifying sovereign sukuk issuance.
n2a05358ef4.why: Asset transfers to the state treasury can support debt reduction efforts and make sovereign sukuk issuance easier for investors.
